 I am potential beneficiary of the Saini Family Trust. The trust was not established for political reasons, and I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by paragraph 41.3(1)(a) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to use any distribution of the trust’s assets on its termination for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign within the meaning of the Canada Elections Act.
I am potential beneficiary of a joint partner trust that holds an interest in Cariboo Gold Pellets Ltd and WL Forestry Supplies Ltd. The trust was not established for political reasons, and I am ordered by the Conflict of Interest and Ethics Commissioner, as required by paragraph 41.3(1)(a) of the Parliament of Canada Act, not to use any distribution of the trust’s assets on its termination for the purpose of financing a nomination contest, a leadership contest or an electoral campaign within the meaning of the Canada Elections Act.
